title: Finite Foundry
summary: Plan six factory routes and finish the campaign in one or two evenings.
user: Incremental-game players who want a satisfying campaign without perpetual prestige or microtransactions.
smallest_useful_product: A 90-minute factory campaign in six chapters. Set a 5-minute production plan, return to solve a new routing constraint, then dismantle the final machine for a credits ending.
constraints: No prestige, energy timers, ads, loot mechanics, or pay-to-progress
